description: This file defines interfaces related to warning reporting within the WPEFramework. It includes interface definitions for warning events, warning reporting units, and control mechanisms for managing warning categories and configurations.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: An interface for warning events, providing methods to serialize, deserialize, categorize, and convert to string.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: An interface representing a warning reporting unit that can report warning events and manage categories.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: An interface for controlling warning reporting categories, allowing exclusion, configuration, and cloning.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event with an identifier and event information.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific warning category, including its default status, enabled status, exclusions, and configuration.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a category control to the warning reporting unit.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a category control from the warning reporting unit.

methods.name: Exclude
methods.description: Excludes a specific category from reporting or consideration.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures category settings based on the provided string.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the warning reporting control.
